Strategy: One-item-above-minimum targeting. Prefer the bin whose residual is closest to the smallest feasible residual plus one item size, with a slight tilt toward tighter fits. The choice differs from Best Fit when the tightest bin is much smaller than that target while another bin sits near it. It may help by preserving the tightest slot for a future item that needs it, but may fail if no later item needs that tight slot.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    mn = min(bins)
    return [-abs(r - (mn + item)) - 0.05 * (r - item) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: One-item-above-minimum targeting: bin whose residual is closest to min+item wins, slight BF tilt.
